calc_items.title: Plan B
calc_items.question: An 11-kg toddler has some dehydration. Calculate the initial ORS volume over four hours.
calc_items.working: 75×11 = 825 mL over 4 h; ongoing losses extra.

calc_items.title: Plan C infant
calc_items.question: An 8-kg, 9-month-old has severe dehydration without shock. Calculate the 30 mL/kg and 70 mL/kg phase volumes.
calc_items.working: 240 mL in the first 1 h, 560 mL over the next 5 h, total 800 mL; monitor.

calc_items.title: Stool osmotic gap
calc_items.question: Stool Na 35 mmol/L and K 25 mmol/L; assume osmolality 290. Calculate the stool osmotic gap.

calc_items.title: CALC-D20-C8 repair
calc_items.question: Arterial O₂ content 19 mL/dL; venous O₂ content 14 mL/dL. Calculate C(a−v)O₂.
calc_items.working: 19 − 14 = 5 mL O₂/dL blood. Prior failure status Active; do not mark passed.

calc_items.title: CALC-D21-C6 repair
calc_items.question: A 28-kg child is prescribed a second adenosine dose of 0.2 mg/kg IV rapid push under a protocol with a 12-mg maximum. Calculate the dose.
calc_items.working: 0.2×28 = 5.6 mg, below the 12-mg cap; IV rapid push with flush under monitored local protocol. Prior failure Active.
